title: Partizan Serial Nim
summary: A combinatorial game is a two-player game without hidden information or chance elements. The main object of combinatorial game theory is to determine the outcome (i.e., which player has a winning strategy) of a given position in combinatorial games. Nim is a well-known and fundamental ruleset in combinatorial game theory.
